meta.name: Borealis
meta.author: dustycompiler
meta.cadence: updates every 15 min via GitHub Action

market.usd_market_cap_source: derived: price × RPC circulating supply (not CoinGecko mcap)
market.note: 24h % = (last − open) / open from Coinbase 24h stats. Quote volume = last × base SOL volume.

rwa.source: defillama.protocols chainTvls.Solana where category in {RWA, RWA Lending}

active_addresses.note: solana.com/data publishes several vendor series for the same label. Values disagree; Borealis does not average them.

sampled.priority_note: priority est. = meta.fee − 5000×n_signatures (base fee 5000 lamports/sig). Sampled, NOT a 24h census.
sampled.source: Solana RPC getBlock meta.fee (finalized, time-stratified sample)
sampled.sampled_runrate_note: sum(meta.fee) 0.0594 SOL over 9961s × 86400. ESTIMATED 24h in-protocol fees from the stratified sample, not a ledger.
sampled.note: NOT a 24h census. Time-stratified getBlock sample: 2 adjacent tip blocks (spot) + 12 slots spread over a ~2.8h window (target 10800s; ≤160 txs/slot subsampled). n_tx=2240 all-tx, n_nonvote=1166, window_seconds=9961. p50 is all-tx meta.fee; non-vote p50 is separate. Do not read n=2240 as a 24h ledger — wall-clock window is 9961s.

economics.median_tx_fee_note: NOT a 24h census. Time-stratified getBlock sample: 2 adjacent tip blocks (spot) + 12 slots spread over a ~2.8h window (target 10800s; ≤160 txs/slot subsampled). n_tx=2240 all-tx, n_nonvote=1166, window_seconds=9961. p50 is all-tx meta.fee; non-vote p50 is separate. Do not read n=2240 as a 24h ledger — wall-clock window is 9961s.
economics.priority_note: priority est. = meta.fee − 5000×n_signatures (base fee 5000 lamports/sig). Sampled, NOT a 24h census.

jito.tips_24h_note: ESTIMATED Jito tips 24h = landed tip-floor p50 (0.00000519 SOL) × non-vote TPS (2375) × 86400. Assumes every non-vote tx pays the p50 floor — an upper-ish bound on floor-priced tips, not a Jito ledger. Not added from DeFiLlama.
jito.sensitivity: sensitivity (not a Jito ledger): tips at p50 floor → 103192 USD; at p95 floor → 19890485 USD. Headline REV uses p50.
jito.sensitivity_note: sensitivity (not a Jito ledger): tips at p50 floor → 103192 USD; at p95 floor → 19890485 USD. Headline REV uses p50.

economics.rev_definition: Borealis REV follows Blockworks/Helius: in-protocol transaction fees (vote + base + priority) plus out-of-protocol Jito tips. DeFiLlama Solana protocol/application fees are NOT REV and are not summed.
economics.rev_window: 24h (solana.com Fees date = network_fees_date; Jito is a 24h run-rate from the live floor)
economics.rev_sensitivity: sensitivity (not a Jito ledger): tips at p50 floor → 103192 USD; at p95 floor → 19890485 USD. Headline REV uses p50.

rev_components.label: Jito tips 24h
rev_components.source: ESTIMATED Jito tips 24h = landed tip-floor p50 (0.00000519 SOL) × non-vote TPS (2375) × 86400. Assumes every non-vote tx pays the p50 floor — an upper-ish bound on floor-priced tips, not a Jito ledger. Not added from DeFiLlama.

rev_routes_tried.route: getBlock stratified sample run-rate (sum meta.fee / window_seconds × 86400)
rev_routes_tried.role: ESTIMATED in-protocol cross-check, not added (would double-count solana.com Fees)
ESTIMATED sensitivity only, not summed into headline REV
EXCLUDED — application/protocol fees, not network REV

economics.rev_label: Borealis REV 24h · MEASURED in-protocol + ESTIMATED Jito tips
economics.total_rev_note: Borealis REV follows Blockworks/Helius: in-protocol transaction fees (vote + base + priority) plus out-of-protocol Jito tips. DeFiLlama Solana protocol/application fees are NOT REV and are not summed. This run: MEASURED in-protocol + ESTIMATED Jito tips. Protocol fees 14076810.839999998 USD are listed separately and excluded.

parts.detail: mean slot 366 ms vs 400 ms target (400→30, 800→0)
TPS 4,241 vs solana.com/data Transaction Count (Total)|Allium / 86400 3,531 (ratio capped at 1.0)

health_score.cadence: updates every 15 min via GitHub Action

active_addresses.note: solana.com/data publishes several vendor series for the same label. Values disagree; Borealis does not average them.

derived.avg_fee_note: Average fee per successful non-vote tx (Fees SOL / count). Median tx fee is not published on these public feeds.

items.title:
RT by @anza_xyz: We've been looking at agave profiles after yesterday's massive spike and for the first time ever, not a single thing went wrong. Not even a minor glitch.

This despite the fact that we know 4.3 is already so much faster and less jittery than 4.2.

We can already do 10k tps easily. There is one last known bottleneck in turbine we're working on, after which we can do 100k and I can retire.

timeline_public.item: solana.com/news “Lowering Slot Time and Validators Economic” is the primary public write-up for the SIMD-525 listing token (SIMD-0525).
SIMD-0525 created (Anza). Four feature gates: 350/300/250/200 ms.
Agave v4.2 schedule targeted the four SIMD-0525 steps on mainnet one epoch apart; schedule is tentative. First step is 400→350 ms.
Observed mean slot 366 ms is consistent with the 350 ms SIMD-0525 target (staged 400→350→300→250→200). INFERRED corroboration, not a feature-gate RPC.
SIMD-0387 (BLS pubkey in vote account) activated on mainnet.
SIMD-0357 VAT activated. VAT does not itself turn on Alpenglow consensus.

watch: Whether observed slot time stays near the inferred SIMD-0525 target after the next epoch.
Skip rate / skipped slots as later 50 ms steps (300/250/200) are considered.
Agave 4.2 / 4.3 stake rollout vs the published (tentative) schedule.
Firedancer / Frankendancer Votor parity before a full Alpenswitch.
editorial.disclaimer: Editorial. Listing token SIMD-525 cites solana.com/news “Lowering Slot Time and Validators Economic”. Observed slot time is INFERRED corroboration, not a feature-gate RPC. Activation dates move. None of this is a live consensus metric.
